title: Synthetic Data Generation for Cardiovascular Disease Risk Prediction
summary: A research repository exploring synthetic data generation methods, including GAN-based ECG synthesis and tabular data augmentation, to support cardiovascular disease risk prediction models. Its Data_augmentation scripts use SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer to fit and sample synthetic clinical record forms (CRFs) for oversampling minority classes.
evidence: Data_augmentation/CTGAN_script.py:11-16 fits CTGANSynthesizer and samples 421 rows; TVAE_script.py does the same with TVAESynthesizer
